# Recreation Prompt

Recreate `Dream Chrono Meme Foundry` as a mobile-first browser-native first-person raycast maze game. Preserve the source mechanic truth: a 24x24 wall/empty maze, drag-controlled forward/back movement and rotation, tap interaction for nearby forward-facing entities, hostile chasers that damage health on contact, collectibles that increment a counter and respawn after delay, game-over on zero health, and restart reset. Rebuild all presentation around a dreamy time-travel laboratory meme factory. The player is a sleepy meme factory worker drifting a time cart through chrono corridors. Hazards are magenta paradox memes, rewards are caption cores, health is shift focus, and restart is clocking in again. Use inline Canvas/CSS/JS, procedural clock rings, lab-grid overlays, caption bubbles, hourglass wall colors, meme-face hazard sprites, crystal-caption reward sprites, compact catalog-backed reaction GIF cards, approved mysterious audio, and catalog fonts Orbitron, Rajdhani, and Bangers. Keep CTAs readable and tappable in portrait mobile.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: mobile-first first-person raycast maze survival/collection game
- objective: navigate a procedurally generated 24x24 maze, avoid or purge hostile entities, collect respawning gems, and keep health above zero.
- input model: pointer drag steers movement and rotation; short tap interacts with nearby forward-facing entities; restart button resets after defeat.
- core loop: spawn in maze, drag to traverse and turn, tap to clear nearby threats or collect rewards, watch health and reward counter, survive until overwhelmed, restart.
- fail/friction state: enemies chase when nearby and deal repeated contact damage; health reaches zero to show a game-over overlay with collected reward count.

## Protected mechanics
- 24x24 wall/empty-cell maze with border walls and randomized interior walls.
- Raycast first-person rendering with collision against wall cells.
- Player starts at the first available empty cell, faces down a corridor, and moves by drag-based forward/back plus rotation.
- Five hostile chasers and five collectible items spawn on empty cells; chasers pursue within aggro range and damage on close contact.
- Tap interaction checks nearby active entities roughly in front of the player; enemies clear in one hit and collectibles increment the counter then respawn later.
- Health, collected count, game-over, restart, SFX, and haptic feedback semantics remain intact.

## Remixed target
Dream Chrono Meme Foundry: the player is a sleepy meme factory worker in a time-travel lab, drifting through luminous production corridors to stamp hostile paradox memes and recover dream-caption crystals. Mechanics remain the same first-person maze survival/collection loop; presentation, HUD language, procedural forms, background overlays, and feedback become dreamy, deterministic, chrono-lab themed, and meme-factory specific.
